en.description:
PilotEnRoute is a study and record-keeping companion for pilots and student pilots. It is a training tool for use on the ground — not an avionics or navigation product.

—— Study ——

FAA EDUCATION
Ground-school material organised by subject, with exams, flashcards and a debrief so you can see what you actually know rather than what you have read.

DRONE TRAINING
Part 107 material for remote pilots.

CAREER
Guidance on ratings and the path between them.

—— Tools ——

E6B
The flight computer, in your pocket.

FLIGHT PLANNER
Work through a plan on the ground, with fuel and weight considerations.

CHECKLISTS
Build and follow your own checklists.

AIRPORT AND CHARTS
Airport information and chart reference for study and briefing.

WEATHER
Live weather from public aviation sources, for situational awareness while planning.

—— Records ——

LOGBOOK
A digital logbook for your hours.

ENDORSEMENTS AND DOCUMENTS
Keep your endorsements and documents together, with a reminder before your medical expires.

—— No account required ——

Sign-in is optional. Tap "Continue as guest" and everything is available.

—— Read this before you fly ——

PilotEnRoute is NOT approved for navigation and must not be used as a primary or sole source for any flight operation. It is not an EFB replacement, not a substitute for official charts, official weather briefings, the AIM, or your POH/AFM, and it is not certified by the FAA or any aviation authority. Every figure in it is for study and planning only. Verify everything against official sources, and comply with all applicable regulations and with your instructor's guidance.

en.release_notes:
First release of PilotEnRoute.

• FAA ground-school study with exams, flashcards and debriefs
• Part 107 drone training
• E6B flight computer, flight planner, fuel and weight tools
• Build-your-own checklists, airport information and chart reference
• Digital logbook, endorsements and documents, with a medical-expiry reminder
• Live weather from public aviation sources
• Sign-in optional - "Continue as guest" unlocks everything

Not approved for navigation. A study and planning tool only - always verify against official sources.

Feedback: contact@americangroup.ai

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
PilotEnRoute is a study and record-keeping companion for pilots and student pilots. It is a training tool for use on the ground — not an avionics or navigation product.

Intended audience:
FAA study, logbook & E6B

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
The app opens on a sign-in screen. An account is optional; the main features can be reached without signing in.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Supabase — account and data storage
- Google AdMob — advertising
- Google Sign-In — authentication
- Sign in with Apple — authentication
- HTTPS requests to the app's own endpoints
- Free public data APIs, no account: OpenSky Network (live traffic), adsbdb.com (aircraft lookup by registration), U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (career median pay), aviationweather.gov (weather)

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
Account deletion is in the app: open the menu (drawer) > Account > Delete account.
